analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입했으나, MACD 히스토그램은 악화 중. ADX 7.7로 추세 형성 미약하여 방향성 부재. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.74로 위축된 거래량은 매수세 유입 부족 시사.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI entered oversold territory, but MACD histogram is worsening. ADX at 7.7 indicates weak trend formation, suggesting lack of directional conviction. Volume ratio of 0.74 (below 5-day average) signals subdued trading activity, implying insufficient buying pressure.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (210.3152 → -292.2741): worsening, signal of bearish reversal
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 104,838 KRW): approaching lower band, moderate band width at 9.04%
[Support & Resistance]

[Volume & Conclusion]
